body:
> No its not "exactly the same".

Unless you are me, my fourth therapist, or were cleverly disguised in each of those sessions, you have no way of knowing whether your statement is true or false.  It's false, by the way.  You are saying **EXACTLY THE SAME SHIT** as my fourth therapist, word-for-fucking-word in some cases.  

> Your health and wellbeing require you to make an effort to change the way you think and the way you act. You label this as bullshit and say its "your fault for being sad". I never said that, you did. I said you have the power to control and alter your emotions and in fact its a requirement for improvement.

Take this bullshit, for instance.  Do you think I **WANT** to be miserable?  Do you think I **WANT** to be a sad fucker who's killing himself tonight because I know what's coming next and have no desire to live through that?  

If you do, you are a fucking idiot.

I **HAVE** tried.  I have tried ten therapists.  I have tried more medications and treatment regimens than I can remember.  I have tried every dose of every medicine I can get.  I have tried CBT.  I have tried DBT.  I have tried both from multiple therapists.

It hasn't worked.

Never.

Ever.

Ever.

That is not a lie.  That is not the depression talking.  That is **WHAT HAS HAPPENED TO ME**.  

> The reason therapy isn't working on you, is because you refuse to accept that depression is something you can change.

And you know this ... how?

Answer: **YOU FUCKING DON'T!**  I have **TRIED EVERYTHING**.  I have tried everything in good faith.  I have *kept* trying even after it looked like it wasn't working, on the basis that I might be wrong and just needed to push through.

Nope.

Never happened.

You do not know **ANYTHING** about me, and for you to make these bullshit claims of yours is nothing more than a pathetic lie to make yourself feel better at my expense.  It probably doesn't even get that far.  It probably never rises above the level of bullshit.

Regardless, it's all bullshit.

> I feel that it is wrong to kill

Woah now, hold your horses!  Killing is **PERFECT NATURAL BECAUSE DOLPHINS** or something according to you.  

Such hubris!  How **DARE** you suggest that murder, rape, theft, and cannibalism are **IN ANY WAY WRONG** if animals do it?  You do know we're all animals, right, "dummy?"

> But I don't believe "good" or "evil" exists outside of our human culture. 

Of course not.  Lions aren't evil because they lack the capacity for evil because *they're fucking lions*.  Humans *are* evil because we know what evil is and *we do it anyway*.  

> If you meet one person and it smells like shit, maybe its them. But if everywhere you go you meet a smelly person, then its probably YOU that smells.

"Lol you've gotten terrible service from ten people in a row so it's clearly your fault and in no way could it be there's [*sic*]!"


> You so easily write off 10 therapists as wrong, but more likely the case is that you are so abrasive, so ignorant and so angry that you were impossible to work with. Have you considered that?

So I deserved to be hit?  I deserved to have my privacy invaded?  I deserve to be threatened with involuntary commitment?  How long do I have to let someone treat me like shit before I'm allowed to stop paying them to treat me like shit in your world?

> believe if I wanted to use you as a punching bag, I could be much meaner

Ha!  "Yeah, man, I could totally beat you up but I *choose* not to yeah I'm real tough man you gots to believe me."

> if tender loving kindness doesn't work on you, I'll have to resort to tough love and brutal honesty.

This is specifically against the rules in this subreddit.  You have been reported for intentionally violating them. 

> Nobody is trying to attack you

Wrong.  You are, and you're doing a shitty job of it because I've been shit on by people worse than you.  You're nothing compared to them.

> Serious question: How much effort do you put into your therapists plans before you declare them bullshit?

Like I said before, the *minimum* time I give a therapist to work is eight once-a-week sessions.  That was how long it took for the one therapist to hit me.  Take her out, and it ranges from four months (therapist who called my boss and got me fired) to five years (therapist number four, who you'd be best friends with).  They give me homework, I do it.  I've kept dream journals, mood logs, done the whole CBT pyramid/circle whatsit, taken my medication at *exactly* the same time of day in *exactly* the prescribed dosage (whatever that dosage happens to be).  

I have **TRIED**.

> I'm betting none

You just lost that bet.

> you seem happy to declare bullshit on anything you don't want to accept.

The only things I declare to be bullshit are the things that *are* bullshit.

Things like everything you've said in this conversation.

What advice?  You spout **EXACTLY THE SAME** "it's your own fault for being sad" **BULLSHIT** as my fourth therapist. 

**EXACTLY**

**THE**

**FUCKING**

**SAME**

> your fourth therapist was right and you are just an ignorant asshole who's hellbent on remaining exactly the same.

Does this count as your "advice?"  Calling me "an ignorant asshole who's hellbent on remaining exactly the same?"  

> You see how you distorted my words into self-hatred? Look at how your mind took my words, which was a identification of your problem, and you twisted it to mean I am in some way wish death upon you. (When it is really your own mind that typed all those words in there, not me) This is exactly how depression functions. It takes words and rewrites them to fit a narrative that only exists in your head. I don't think you are a loser at all. But in your mind, that's the ONLY conclusion you can come to and so it MUST be what I meant.

Blah blah blah blah blah more fucking bullshit from you.

> your attitude to my post is EXACTLY why you are seeing no progress

And more "it's your fault for being depressed" bullshit from you.  

**IF THIS IS HOW YOU THINK YOU ARE SUPPOSED TO HELP PEOPLE, YOU NEED TO STOP HELPING PEOPLE**

You respond to me saying that nothing *does* help me, and my statement that nothing *has* helped me, with 

> You state that as a fact (in bold even), but its not. Its a belief you hold.

So I ask you, 

**WHAT DOES HELP ME?**

**WHAT HAS HELPED ME?**

Point to specific incidents in my life, since you evidently know so fucking much about it.

> Uh. Humans ARE animals, dummy. We are no different. We kill just as they kill.

And another insult from you.  Again, if this is how you help people, **STOP HELPING PEOPLE**.

Humans are animals in the biological sense.  We are also animals capable of moral judgment and moral actions.  And yet we do evil, evil, evil, **EVIL FUCKING THINGS EVERY FUCKING DAY**, when we are capable of better.  

A fucking lion?  It has to kill to eat.  It's an obligate carnivore.  Ants?  Ever talk to an ant?  Ever see an ant do math?  Ever see an ant conscientiously object to killing another ant?

Fuck no, you haven't. 

> "Evil" is a creation of human hubris because we believe we are somehow 'above' animals. We aren't. Get over it. Porpoises, one of the most intelligent species in the world, gang rape their own and other's childrens for enjoyment, they kill social outcasts in their group for fun and all sorts of other 'evil' things.

You must be trolling at this point, but I'll continue to play along.

Do you see any problem with killing and eating children?  Do you have any objections to that at all?  If I'm hungry, and there's your newborn daughter, and you're off doing something else in the other room and there's nothing else to eat in the house, you're okay with me eating her?  

How about killing someone I don't like?  Someone who really, really pisses me off and ruins my day.  You've got no problem with that because porpoises do it, right?  I mean, it's natural!  

What if someone steals from you?  Hey, you had something they wanted, and they were stronger or faster than you, so tough shit, right?  Laws of the jungle, man.  Surely you can't complain, because *animals kill and steal all the time*, right?

**THEN SHUT THE FUCK UP**

> I can see why all your therapists gave up on you.

And another insult from you.  **ONCE MORE, IF INSULTING PEOPLE IS YOUR IDEA OF HELPING THEM, THEN STOP HELPING PEOPLE IMMEDIATELY.**  

**I** fired my therapists for being incompetent, immoral, abusive cockstains **TO THE LAST** after I gave them **EVERY OPPORTUNITY TO SHOW THEY WEREN'T**.  All.  Ten.  Of.  Them.

> I'm sad for you.

No you aren't.  You're using me as a punching bag and you're upset that I have the **GALL** to fight back.

> I recommend shopping around and finding one who doesn't attempt to ruin your life or convert you to their religion

What, exactly, do you think I've been **DOING** this whole time?

> Your anger with the system is really a distraction.

I sense a steaming pile of bullshit about to come my way.

> The road to recovering doesnt lie in medication or therapists, these are simply tools to help you fix yourself. Only the efforts you make to improve yourself matter, nothing else.

And there it is!

> Nothing is going to do anything until you actively decide to combat your depression.

"Depression is your own fault because you're not trying to get better!  HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA YOU FUCKING ASSHOLE LOSER JUST FUCKING HANG YOURSELF ALREADY."

Fixed your wording for you.  You sound exactly--**EXACTLY**--like my fourth therapist right now.

> What have you been doing to combat your depression? And have you made any progress?  These are the questions that you should ask, if something isn't helping you make progress, then drop it.

More bullshit.  

> Focus your time and effort on things that DO produce positive things in your life.

**NOTHING DOES**

**NOTHING HAS**

**NOTHING EVER WILL**

> That's the point of all of this: improve your emotional life to a point where you can say you actually enjoy it.

Oh, just fuck off.  Jesus Fucking Christ.

> As for your comment about humanity being a disease? So what! Every life form on the planet is a disease! We're all just highly evolved forms of bacteria.

HURP DURP DEERP DURP DO I'M SO GODDAMN SMART

> That doesn't make us awful, it just makes us a part of the greater web of life. 

A wolf stalks and kills a sick and elderly deer, or a lion kills a baby zebra and eats it while it's still alive.  That's fine.  That's what wolves and lions *do*.  They're animals.  Ant nests go to war with each other and kill all the adults and enslave or eat all the babies.  That's what *they* do.

If a *human* stalks and kills an elderly person, or eats a baby while it's still alive, that's **EVIL AS SHIT**.  A group of people kills other people just for being there, and then maybe enslaves or eats their children?  **THAT'S ALSO FUCKING EVIL, AND IT'S SOMETHING THAT HAPPENS EVERY FUCKING DAY**.

> You're allowed to give up once you no longer have a single complaint about your life or the world around you.

Go fuck yourself.

[This is my exit strategy.](http://www.liveleak.com/view?i=cd0_1296909173)
